title: Mixed Equilibrium In Compact Continuous Games
body_html:
Mixed Equilibrium In Compact Continuous Games

If $G$ is compact and continuous, then its set of mixed equilibria is a nonempty compact subset of $$ \prod_{i\in I}\Delta(S_i). $$
proof_html:
Sketch

The mixed strategy spaces $\Delta(S_i)$ are compact in the weak-star topology. The expected payoff functions in the mixed extension are continuous and multilinear, hence quasi-concave in each player's mixed strategy. Applying the compact quasi-concave existence theorem to the mixed extension yields a nonempty compact set of mixed equilibria.
